---
title: "Exercise Guidelines"
---

The exercises are designed to help you apply each statistical method during the workshop.

## Exercise File

A single exercise file contains all activities for Sections 1–6. The code is partially completed, and you will fill in the missing parts as we work through each section.

[Download the exercise files](workshop_exercises.zip)

## Posit Cloud

You can complete the workshop directly in Posit Cloud without installing R or RStudio.

[Open the workshop in Posit Cloud](https://posit.cloud/content/12868361)

After opening the project:

1. Sign in to Posit Cloud or create a free account.
2. Open the workshop project.
3. Select **Save a Permanent Copy** to create your own copy.
4. Work through the workshop sections in order.
5. Complete the exercises in `workshop_exercises.qmd`.


## Workshop Order

Work through the exercises in this order:

**Data Exploration → Correlation → Linear Regression → ANOVA → Linear Mixed Model → Nonlinear Regression**

Focus on understanding **what the model does, why it is appropriate, and how to interpret the results**, rather than memorizing the R code.
